I4.quote: Searched text, tables and figures for BET, Langmuir or any m2/g area of a measured sample; none found (characterization is TEM, Raman, TGA only). The only area, MgO support "(100 m2·g-1)" (p. 2, Section II.A), is a synthesis reagent.

I5.quote: The aim of this study was to synthesize the single walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) and determine their hydrogen storage capacities.

notes: Uptake measured volumetrically (HPVA-100, He-calibrated) at -196 °C, 0.1-100 bar, on seven HNO3 microwave-purified CVD SWCNT samples (residual catalyst 1.23-6.84%, so carbon is the majority component). No surface area is reported for any SWCNT sample. The MgO support's 100 m2/g is a property of a synthesis reagent on which the paper reports no measurement; I did not count it under I4. The introduction's statement that microwave digestion increases surface area refers to literature [2] and gives no value. Not a review, thesis or patent; no retraction or prior-publication statement.
